**Finding: Compliant (preferred position)** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Bluefly:

- **§ 14.8 Personnel** (the expected home for such a restriction) covers only each party's supervision/direction/control of its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel, and IBM's right to subcontract — no hiring restraint.
- Document-wide searches for *solicit*, *hire*, *employ*, *induce*, *recruit*, and *personnel* surfaced no restrictive covenant; the only "employ" hits are definitional ("employee or Subcontractor of Customer") and indemnity references to employees/officers/directors.

Because our playbook's preferred position is **no non-solicit on Customer**, the absence of any such clause is the best available outcome. There is nothing to narrow (duration, scope, or general-advertising carve-out) and nothing to delete. We should simply resist any attempt by IBM to add a non-solicit or no-hire in negotiation; if one is introduced, the fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from end of involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire) would be our ask.
